title: HPSC HCS Civil Services Mains Result, Interview Date 2026 for 102 Post
intro: HPSC HCS Civil Services & Allied Services Recruitment 2026 Notification Out! Apply online for 102 HCS & Allied posts (Advt No. 22/2026) starting 06 February 2026. Last date 26 February 2026 (05:00 PM). Graduate eligible. Age 18-27/42 years. Fee Rs. 1000/- General, Rs. 250/- Reserved/Female Haryana. Pre Exam 26 April 2026, Mains 27-29 June 2026. Get updates on admit card, syllabus, eligibility, pay scale, selection (Pre, Mains, Interview, DV, Medical). Trending: HPSC HCS 2026, हरियाणा सिविल सर्विसेज भर्ती 2026, HPSC HCS Vacancy 102 2026, HPSC Prelims 26 April 2026. (Updated 18 September 2026, 03:32 PM IST)
